_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY. incumbent virtualbox = the original live-snapshot goal (bare metal, 96 vCPU quota). Every OWNER value must be set; host_run check refuses placeholders. No price is verified. mode architecture_measurement is the honest default: it is labelled NOT_A_COMPARISON and may differ; mode comparison needs the real image manifest plus measured, digest-bound equivalence evidence for every detected software difference and NO stub.
memory_admission_mib: OWNER: integer MiB of MemAvailable required at check time (an admission rule, not a derived minimum)
external_watcher_confirmed_by: OWNER: name of the person who started awsctl watch
